body: The full fitted candidate must be physical,exactly TP and certified at the exhausted observable rank over the entire future/terminal interface. Counts do not acquire the source rank/dimension/stationarity/reset promises. Both endpoints must terminate;an independent abort clock suffices. The real-algebraic search is finite but potentially enormous and has not been implemented. This is classical transcript TV,not source-memory cq/diamond distance,normalized rare-history control or arbitrary new inputs. Raw joint-core acquisition remains candidate;its feedback/reset-heralding correction is retained. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
